rubrics.justification: Generally recognizes an expanded blastocyst with thinned zona, but overinterprets ICM/TE quality from a single suboptimal image and introduces features like lack of degeneration/hatching issues that are not confidently assessable here; also questions the reported 3AA without strong image basis.
Thoroughly integrates age, prior failed cycles, tubal factor, endometrium, ovarian response, BMI, and male factors with embryo morphology and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with a plausible prognosis range tied to age and prior failures; minor issue is leaning heavily on uncertain image-based downgrading of the reported AA quality.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice: single embryo transfer, luteal support, uterine cavity/hydrosalpinx review, and selective discussion of PGT-A. Minor deviations include somewhat speculative emphasis on sperm DNA fragmentation and lifestyle details.

Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer and future cycles, including uterine/tubal reassessment, review of prior cycle embryology, selective PGT-A discussion, and male-factor follow-up.
